purpose: Teach: 投げかけ/飼料/熟練/義務付け/ステンレス/預かり/行き過ぎ/混在

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様に、新しい提案、投げかけて、反応、しっかり、見ていきましょうね、来月の販促、本当に、勝負よ。
lines.en: Let's put forward a strong new proposal to the client and carefully watch their reaction. Next month's promotional push is really make-or-break for us.
lines.style: Clipped, energetic opening. Purposeful pacing. She's setting stakes, not negotiating. Short phrases building momentum. The 'really' carries weight—this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。畜産関連の、飼料事業、新規参入、検討中です、来年から、本格化、進める方針です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently studying entry into the livestock feed business as a new venture. The plan is to ramp up full operations next year.
lines.style: Attentive, measured delivery. Slight pause between topics—showing he's tracking her priorities and responding to each one. Professional but not stiff. Calm confidence in the details.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 熟練社員のノウハウ、しっかり、デジタル化していきましょう、若手に、伝わるよう、必要よね、本当に、急務よ。
lines.en: We need to digitize the technical knowledge our experienced staff have so it actually reaches the younger team members. That's become urgent now.
lines.style: Forward-leaning tone. Clear and directive but not harsh. She's identifying what needs to happen and trusting him to understand why. Steady emphasis on 'digitize' and 'reaches'—the method matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法律で、義務付けられた研修、社員、漏れなく、参加させております、徹底中、本当に、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. We're making sure every employee attends the legally required training without exception. We've been very thorough about it lately, especially.
lines.style: Straightforward, slightly formal. He's reporting completion and diligence. The emphasis falls on 'thorough'—showing he understands this is where attention should be. No hedging.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品の本体、ステンレス、高級感、出るわよね、お客様にも、本当に、好評な反応、いただいてるよね。
lines.en: The new product's stainless steel body really does give off that premium feel. We're getting genuinely positive feedback from clients on it.
lines.style: Warm, approving tone. She's pleased about this and lets it show. Opens slightly brighter than before. The approval is genuine, not performative. Slight lift at 'genuinely positive'—she means it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内預かり金、運用、慎重に、進めております、リスク管理、徹底中です、本当に、しっかり。
lines.en: Yes. We're managing the internal reserve funds carefully and maintaining strict risk controls. We're being very careful about how we handle it.
lines.style: Measured, almost cautious delivery. He's showing attention to something sensitive. Not defensive, but precise—emphasizing 'carefully' and 'strict' to show this is being done right. Professional and reassuring.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 最近、ネット広告、行き過ぎている部分、見直しが、必要よね、社内、共通認識、深めましょう、本当に。
lines.en: I've noticed online advertising has been pushing too far lately. We need to pull back on some of it. Let's build a shared understanding about this in the company.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly concerned opening. She's not criticizing sharply—this is more a moment of noticing something that needs correction. Measured pace. The 'really' is gentle, not imperious. Collaborative framing on 'build a shared understanding'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い技術と新技術、混在する現場、若手も、ベテランも、お互いに、学んでいますね、活発化中、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We have old technology and new technology mixed in on the work sites, and both the newer and experienced staff are learning from each other quite a lot. The momentum's really building there.
lines.style: Calm, observant tone. He's noting something positive that's already happening. Warm approval underneath. Slightly slower pace—he's painting a picture of collaboration. The 'really building' carries quiet satisfaction.
